</div><div><a id="a_031"></a></div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><b>ENVOY MEDICAL, INC.</b></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><b>NOTES TO UNAUDITED CONDENSED
CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</b></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><b>(Dollars in thousands,
except share and per share data)</b></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&#160;</p><div>

</div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" escape="true" name="us-gaap:NatureOfOperations" id="ixv-3535"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>1. Nature of the Business and Basis of Presentation
</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Envoy Medical, Inc. (&#8220;Envoy
Medical&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;) is a hearing health company focused on the development of fully implanted hearing solutions.
The Company has developed two fully implanted hearing devices built around the Company&#8217;s proprietary sensor technology, which is
implanted in the middle ear. These fully implanted hearing devices are designed to leverage the ear&#8217;s natural anatomy to capture
sound and eliminate the need for external or subdermal microphones.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Company&#8217;s first
product, the Esteem&#174; Fully Implanted Active Middle Ear Implant (&#8220;Esteem FI-AMEI&#8221;), is a fully implanted active middle
ear hearing device. The Esteem FI-AMEI received approval from the United States Food and Drug Administration (&#8220;FDA&#8221;) in 2010
and remains the only fully implanted hearing device to successfully receive FDA approval.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Company has shifted its
focus to the Company&#8217;s second product, the investigational fully implanted Acclaim&#174; Cochlear Implant (&#8220;Acclaim CI&#8221;),
which the Company believes to be the first fully implantable cochlear implant. The Acclaim CI is designed with no external components
worn on or behind the ear, does not use an external or subdermal microphone and incorporates an implanted rechargeable battery designed
to last several days between charges. The Acclaim CI received the Breakthrough Device Designation from the FDA in 2019. The Acclaim CI
is designed to address sensorineural hearing loss that is not adequately addressed by hearing aids. As part of the clinical trial, the
Acclaim CI is intended for adults with severe-to-profound sensorineural hearing loss who have been deemed adequate candidates by a qualified
physician.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On September 29, 2023 (the
&#8220;Closing Date&#8221;), a merger transaction between Envoy Medical Corporation, Anzu Special Acquisition Corp I (&#8220;Anzu&#8221;)
and Envoy Merger Sub, Inc., a directly, wholly owned subsidiary of Anzu (&#8220;Merger Sub&#8221;) was completed (hereinafter, the &#8220;Merger&#8221;
or &#8220;Business Combination&#8221;) pursuant to the business combination agreement, dated as of April 17, 2023 (as amended, the &#8220;Business
Combination Agreement&#8221;). In connection with the closing of the Merger (the &#8220;Closing&#8221;), Merger Sub merged with Envoy
Medical Corporation, with Envoy Medical Corporation surviving the merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of Anzu. In connection with the
Closing, Anzu changed its name to Envoy Medical, Inc. The Company&#8217;s Class A common stock, par value $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c48" decimals="4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8243">0.0001</ix:nonFraction> per share (&#8220;Class
A Common Stock&#8221;), and the Company&#8217;s public warrants commenced trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (&#8220;Nasdaq&#8221;)
on October 2, 2023 under the symbols &#8220;COCH&#8221; and &#8220;COCHW,&#8221; respectively.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On April 17, 2023, prior to
entering into the Business Combination Agreement, Anzu and Envoy Medical Corporation entered into an agreement (as amended to date, the
&#8220;Forward Purchase Agreement&#8221;) with Meteora Special Opportunity Fund I, LP (&#8220;MSOF&#8221;), Meteora Capital Partners,
LP (&#8220;MCP&#8221;), Meteora Select Trading Opportunities Master, LP (&#8220;MSTO&#8221;) and Meteora Strategic Capital, LLC (&#8220;MSC&#8221;
and, collectively with MSOF, MCP and MSTO, the &#8220;Sellers&#8221; or &#8220;Meteora Parties&#8221;) for an over-the-counter equity
prepaid forward transaction.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Pursuant to the terms of the
Forward Purchase Agreement, on the Closing Date, the Sellers purchased <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c49" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesIssuedForServices" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8244">425,606</ix:nonFraction> shares of the Company&#8217;s Class A Common Stock (the
&#8220;Recycled Shares&#8221;) directly from the redeeming stockholders of Anzu. During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Sellers
sold the full amount of the Recycled Shares and, pursuant to the Forward Purchase Agreement, the Company received $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c36" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SaleOfStockPricePerShare" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8245">4.00</ix:nonFraction> per share sold,
or $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c50" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:ProceedsFromPurchaseAgreementAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8246">1,683</ix:nonFraction>. <p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">In addition, pursuant to a

</div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_SignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:SignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock" id="ixv-3579"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>2. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></p>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="coch_GoingConcernsPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="coch:GoingConcernsPolicyTextBlock" id="ixv-3585"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b><i>Liquidity and Going Concern</i></b></p></ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<ix:continuation continuedAt="coch_GoingConcernsPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_2" id="coch_GoingConcernsPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Since inception, the Company
has historically incurred negative operating cash flows and losses from operations as the Company advances the clinical development of
its products and the funding process of clinical FDA trials. These matters raise substantial doubt about the Company&#8217;s ability to
continue as a going concern and although management has developed plans intended to support ongoing operations, such plans do not alleviate
the substantial doubt. As of March 31, 2026, the Company has an accumulated deficit of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:RetainedEarningsAccumulatedDeficit" scale="3" sign="-" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8253">319,097</ix:nonFraction>. <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c63" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8270">27,053,850</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock. The Company had cash of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:Cash" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8271">25,251</ix:nonFraction> as of March 31, 2026.</p></ix:continuation>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<ix:continuation id="coch_GoingConcernsPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_2"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Management believes that its
existing cash balances combined with potential proceeds from the exercise of outstanding warrants (see Note 9) and cash receipts from
product sales will be sufficient to fund ongoing operations, including the Acclaim CI clinical trials, through at least one year from
the date the unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements are issued. However, there can be no assurance that the Company will
be successful in achieving its strategic plans, that the Company&#8217;s cash balances and future capital raises will be sufficient to
support its ongoing operations, or that any additional financing will be available in a timely manner or on acceptable terms, if at all.
If the Company is unable to raise sufficient financing when needed or events or circumstances occur such that the Company does not meet
its strategic plans, the Company may be required to reduce certain of its discretionary spending. The Company may be unable to develop
new or enhanced production methods, or be unable to fund capital expenditures, which could have a material adverse effect on the Company&#8217;s
financial position, results of operations, cash flows, and ability to achieve its intended business objectives. The unaudited condensed
consolidated financial statements have been prepared assuming the Company will continue as a going concern and do not include adjustments
to reflect the possible effects on the recoverability and classification of assets or the amounts and classification of liabilities that
may result from the outcome of this uncertainty.</p></ix:continuation>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></p>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="coch_UnauditedFinancialInformationPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="coch:UnauditedFinancialInformationPolicyTextBlock" id="ixv-3598"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b><i>Unaudited Financial Information</i></b></p></ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<ix:continuation continuedAt="coch_UnauditedFinancialInformationPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_2" id="coch_UnauditedFinancialInformationPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Company&#8217;s unaudited
condensed consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United
States (&#8220;U.S. GAAP&#8221;) for interim financial reporting and with the instructions to Form 10-Q and Rule 10-01 of Regulation S-X.
Pursuant to these rules and regulations, they do not include all information and notes required by U.S. GAAP for complete financial statements.
In the opinion of management, the unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements reflect all adjustments, consisting of a normal
recurring nature, considered necessary for a fair statement of the Company&#8217;s financial condition and results of operations. Operating
results for the periods presented are not necessarily indicative of the results that might be expected for the full year. As such, the
information included in this report should be read in conjunction with the Company&#8217;s audited consolidated financial statements as
of and for the year ended December 31, 2025, which are included in the Company&#8217;s Form 10-K. The condensed consolidated balance sheet
as of December 31, 2025 has been derived from the audited consolidated financial statements of the Company, but does not include all the
disclosures required by U.S. GAAP.</p></ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric><div>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_UseOfEstimates-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:UseOfEstimates" id="ixv-3636"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b><i>Use of Estimates</i></b></p></ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<ix:continuation id="_UseOfEstimates-c0_cont_1"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The preparation of unaudited
condensed consolidated financial statements in conformity with U.S. GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect
the reported amounts of assets, liabilities, and equity; disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the financial
statements; and the reported amounts of revenues and expenses during the reporting period. Actual results could differ from those estimates.
Significant estimates and assumptions reflected in these unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements include but are not limited
to the useful lives of property and equipment, the net realizable value of inventory, product warranty liability, stock-based compensation
expense, the present value of the lease liability, the fair value of the forward purchase agreement warrant liability, the private warrant
liability, and the outcome of litigation. Estimates and assumptions are reviewed periodically and the effect of changes, if any, are reflected
in the unaudited condensed consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss.</p></ix:continuation></ix:continuation><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p><div>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Company has classified
the publicly traded warrant liability within Level 1 of the hierarchy as the warrant is separately listed and traded in an active market.
The publicly traded warrant&#8217;s listed price in an active market was used as the fair value.</p></ix:nonNumeric><div>

</div><ix:continuation id="_ProductWarrantyDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The assumptions utilized in
developing the liability as of March 31, 2026 include an estimated cost per unit of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:EstimatedCostOfWarrantLiabilityPerUnit" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8367">6</ix:nonFraction>, an average sound processor / battery assembly
(&#8220;Battery&#8221;) life of <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" name="coch:AverageBatteryLife" id="ixv-8368">five years</ix:nonNumeric>, inflationary increase of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:AnnualIncreaseInProductPriceDueToInflation" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8369">3.7</ix:nonFraction>%, and an average patient life calculated based on probabilities
outlined in the PRI-2012 mortality tables, published from the Society of Actuaries. Additionally, a discount rate of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualDiscountRate" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8370">5.6</ix:nonFraction>% was used in
the calculation as of March 31, 2026.</p></ix:continuation><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p><div>

</div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_DebtDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:DebtDisclosureTextBlock" id="ixv-4384"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>8. Debt (Related Party) and Interest Expense (Related Party)</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>February 2024 Term Loan</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">In February 2024, the Company
issued a promissory note (the &#8220;February 2024 Term Loan&#8221;) with a minimum principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c117" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8371">5,000</ix:nonFraction> and up to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c118" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8372">10,000</ix:nonFraction> to GAT
Funding, LLC (&#8220;GAT&#8221;), an entity controlled by Glen A. Taylor, then a member of the Company&#8217;s board of directors and
a controlling stockholder of the Company. At closing, the Company drew $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c119" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8373">5,000</ix:nonFraction> from the February 2024 Term Loan. Provided that no event
of default had occurred and the Company submitted a request for funding certifying that the Company had less than $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c119" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:NetTangibleAssets" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8374">7,500</ix:nonFraction> of net tangible
assets, the Company had the ability to draw the remaining $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c120" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:RemainingWithdrawAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8375">5,000</ix:nonFraction> in $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c121" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:RemainingWithdrawAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8376">2,500</ix:nonFraction> tranches, as long as each request was made prior to February
1, 2025. In both May 2024 and July 2024, the Company requested and received additional advances of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c122" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:AdvanceReceivedFromLoan" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8377"><ix:nonFraction contextRef="c123" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:AdvanceReceivedFromLoan" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8378">2,500</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction> under the February 2024 Term
Loan. The outstanding balance on the February 2024 Term Loan, net of discount, was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c124" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LongTermDebtAverageAmountOutstanding" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8379">10,369</ix:nonFraction> at the time the debt was extinguished as discussed
below.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The February 2024 Term Loan
had a five-year term and an original maturity date of <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c124" format="ixt:date-monthname-day-year-en" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDate" id="ixv-8380">February 27, 2029</ix:nonNumeric>. The principal amount drawn bore interest at a rate of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c124" decimals="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8381">8.0</ix:nonFraction>% per
annum and was to be paid quarterly in arrears after the second anniversary of the February 2024 Term Loan. Interest accrued and was not
payable for the first <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c124" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentTerm" id="ixv-8382">two years</ix:nonNumeric> of the term and was compounded and added to the principal balance of the February 2024 Term Loan both
on the first and second anniversary of the February 2024 Term Loan. The Company could prepay the accrued interest and principal of the
February 2024 Term Loan without penalty, with 10 days&#8217; notice.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>August 2024 Term Loan</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.45in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.45in">In August 2024, the Company
issued an additional promissory note (the &#8220;August 2024 Term Loan&#8221;) with a principal amount of up to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c125" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8383">10,000</ix:nonFraction> to GAT. At closing,
the Company drew $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c126" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8384">5,000</ix:nonFraction> from the August 2024 Term Loan. Provided that no event of default had occurred and the Company submitted a request
for funding certifying that the Company had less than $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c126" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:NetTangibleAssets" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8385">7,500</ix:nonFraction> of net tangible assets, the Company had the ability to draw the remaining
$<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c127" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:RemainingWithdrawAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8386">5,000</ix:nonFraction> in $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c128" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:RemainingWithdrawAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8387">2,500</ix:nonFraction> tranches, as long as each request is made prior to August 1, 2025. In December 2024, the Company requested and received
an additional advance of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c129" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:AdvanceReceivedFromLoan" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8388">5,000</ix:nonFraction> under the August 2024 Term Loan. The outstanding balance on the August 2024 Term Loan, net of discount,
was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c130" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LoansPayable" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8389">9,334</ix:nonFraction> at the time the debt was extinguished as discussed below.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.45in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.45in">The August 2024 Term Loan
had a five-year term and an original maturity date of <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c131" format="ixt:date-monthname-day-year-en" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDate" id="ixv-8390">August 27, 2029</ix:nonNumeric>. The principal amount drawn bore interest at a rate of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c131" decimals="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8391">8.0</ix:nonFraction>% per
annum and was to be paid quarterly in arrears after the second anniversary of the August 2024 Term Loan. Interest accrued and was not
payable for the first <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c131" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentTerm" id="ixv-8392">two years</ix:nonNumeric> of the term and was compounded and added to the principal balance of the August 2024 Term Loan both on
the first and second anniversary of the August 2024 Term Loan. The Company could prepay the accrued interest and principal of the August
2024 Term Loan without penalty, with 10 days&#8217; notice.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.45in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.45in">As a commitment fee, the
Company was required to issue warrants to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c132" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8393">250,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of its Class A Common Stock for each $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c133" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:CommonStockValue" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8394">2,500</ix:nonFraction> of principal funded under
the February 2024 Term Loan and August 2024 Term Loan. The warrants have an exercise price equal to the closing price on the date of funding
of the applicable tranche.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>&#160;</i></p>

At the time of their initial issuance, these warrants had a contractual expiration date of <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c136" format="ixt:date-monthname-day-year-en" name="coch:WarrantAndOutstandingExpiredDate" id="ixv-8397">February 27, 2026</ix:nonNumeric>.
Upon the second draw made in May 2024, the Company issued warrants to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c137" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8398">250,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock at an exercise price
of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c122" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:WarrantExercisePriceIncrease" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8399">3.04</ix:nonFraction> per share. of each of these warrants issued in connection with the February 2024 Term Loan have been amended as discussed below.</p></ix:nonNumeric><div>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left"><i>March 2025 Term Loan</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">In March 2025, the Company
issued a promissory note (the &#8220;March 2025 Term Loan&#8221; and, collectively with the February 2024 Term Loan and August 2024 Term
Loan, the &#8220;Term Loans&#8221;) with a minimum principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c145" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8410">5,000</ix:nonFraction> and up to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c146" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8411">10,000</ix:nonFraction> to GAT. At closing, the Company drew $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c147" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8412">5,000</ix:nonFraction>
from the March 2025 Term Loan. Provided that no event of default had occurred and the Company submitted a request for funding certifying
that the Company had less than $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c147" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:OtherIntangibleAssetsNet" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8413">7,500</ix:nonFraction> of net tangible assets, the Company had the ability to draw the remaining $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c148" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:RemainingWithdrawAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8414">5,000</ix:nonFraction> in $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c149" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:RemainingWithdrawAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8415">2,500</ix:nonFraction> tranches,
as long as each request is made prior to March 2026. On June 26, 2025, the Company requested and received an additional advance of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c150" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityAmount" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8416">5,000</ix:nonFraction>
under the March 2025 Term Loan. The balance outstanding on the March 2025 Term Loan was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c148" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LongTermDebtAverageAmountOutstanding" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8417">8,523</ix:nonFraction>, net of discount, at the time the debt
was extinguished as discussed below.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The March 2025 Term Loan had
a five-year term and an original maturity date of <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c148" format="ixt:date-monthname-day-year-en" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDate" id="ixv-8418">March 6, 2030</ix:nonNumeric>. The principal amount drawn bore interest at a rate of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c151" decimals="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8419">8.0</ix:nonFraction>% per annum
and was to be paid quarterly in arrears after the second anniversary of the March 2025 Term Loan. Interest accrued and was not payable
for the first <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c151" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentTerm" id="ixv-8420">two years</ix:nonNumeric> of the term and was compounded and added to the principal balance of the March 2025 Term Loan both on the first
and second anniversary of the March 2025 Term Loan. The Company could prepay the accrued interest and principal of the March 2025 Term
Loan without penalty, with 10 days&#8217; notice.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">As a commitment fee, the Company
was required to issue warrants to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c152" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8421">375,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of its Class A Common Stock for each $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c153" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8422">2,500</ix:nonFraction> of principal funded under the March
2025 Term Loan. The warrants have an exercise price equal to the closing price on the date of funding of the applicable tranche. At closing
of the initial funding of the March 2025 Term Loan, the Company issued warrants to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c154" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8423">750,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock at
an exercise price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c155" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:WarrantExercisePriceIncrease" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8424">1.35</ix:nonFraction> per share. At the time of their initial issuance, these warrants had a contractual expiration date of March
11, 2027. The expiration date has been amended as discussed below.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Upon the second draw made
in June 2025, the Company issued warrants to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c156" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8425">750,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock at an exercise price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c157" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:WarrantExercisePriceIncrease" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8426">1.48</ix:nonFraction>. At the time
of their initial issuances, these warrants had a contractual expiration date of June 26, 2027. The expiration date has been amended as
discussed below. The warrants issued in conjunction with the Term Loans are referred to as &#8220;Term Loan Warrants&#8221;.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Term Loans were accounted
for as a conventional debt instrument and are accounted for in accordance with ASC 470, <i>Debt</i> and ASC 815,&#160;<i>Derivatives and
Hedging</i>&#160;(&#8220;ASC 815&#8221;). As a result of the issuance of the warrants with the February 2024, May 2024 and July 2024 closings
of the February 2024 Term Loan, which met the criteria for equity classification under applicable U.S. GAAP, the Company recorded the
fair value of the warrants on the issuance date in the amount of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c119" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8427">179</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c158" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8428">197</ix:nonFraction>, and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c138" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8429">210</ix:nonFraction>, respectively, as a debt discount and additional
paid-in capital on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets. Subsequently, the amortization of these debt discounts was recorded
to interest expense (related party) over the term of the February 2024 Term Loan.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">As a result of the issuance
of the warrants with the August 2024 and December 2024 closings of the August 2024 Term Loan, which met the criteria for equity classification
under applicable U.S. GAAP, the Company recorded the fair value of the warrants on the issuance date in the amount of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c126" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8430">489</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c142" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8431">321</ix:nonFraction>, respectively,
as a debt discount and additional paid-in capital on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets. Subsequently, the amortization
of these debt discounts was recorded to interest expense (related party) over the term of the August 2024 Term Loan.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">As a result of the issuance
of the warrants with the March 2025 and June 2025 closings of the March 2025 Term Loan, which met the criteria for equity classification
under applicable U.S. GAAP, the Company recorded the fair value of the warrants on the issuance date in the amount of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c147" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8432">688</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c156" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8433">882</ix:nonFraction>, respectively,
as a debt discount and additional paid-in capital on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheet. Subsequently, the amortization
of debt discounts was recorded to interest expense (related party) over the term of the March 2025 Term Loan.</p></ix:continuation><div>

March 31, 2025, the Company recognized $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c12" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebt" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8434">495</ix:nonFraction> of interest expense in relation to the Term Loans. Included within this interest expense total,
the Company recognized $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c12" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AmortizationOfDebtDiscountPremium" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8435">79</ix:nonFraction> of debt discount amortization during the three months ended March 31, 2025.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Debt Extinguishment and Warrant Extension</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On August 25, 2025, the Company
entered into a satisfaction of promissory notes agreement (the &#8220;Satisfaction Agreement&#8221;) with GAT. Pursuant to the stated
terms of the Satisfaction Agreement, GAT agreed to forgive all outstanding principal and accrued interest on the Term Loans in exchange
for a <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c159" name="us-gaap:LongTermDebtContingentPaymentOfPrincipalOrInterest" id="ixv-8436">$100</ix:nonNumeric> payment from the Company.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On September 4, 2025, the
Company entered into a voting and warrant extension agreement (the &#8220;Voting and Extension Agreement&#8221;) with Glen A. Taylor,
GAT, and another affiliated entity. Pursuant to the Voting and Extension Agreement, the Company agreed to extend the expiration date of
the Term Loan Warrants to December 31, 2028. Prior to the extension, the Term Loan Warrants had expiration dates ranging from February
27, 2026 to June 26, 2027. In addition, Glen A. Taylor, GAT, and another affiliated entity agreed to vote in favor of any proposal that
is submitted by the Company for approval by its stockholders under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635 relating to stockholder approval of certain
issuances of securities, provided that the proposal is unanimously approved and recommended by the Board of Directors of the Company.
The voting obligations are in effect through December 31, 2028 and are binding on any transferees of the Class A Common Stock that is
currently held by Glen A. Taylor, GAT or the other affiliated entity. The Voting and Extension Agreement also granted registration rights
to Glen A. Taylor, GAT, or the other affiliated entity upon request on or after March 31, 2026.</p></ix:continuation><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p><div>

</div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock" id="ixv-4496"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>9. Common Stock</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">As of March 31, 2026 and December
31, 2025, the Company was authorized to issue <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c160" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesAuthorized" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8437"><ix:nonFraction contextRef="c161" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesAuthorized" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8438">400,000,000</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock. The voting, dividend and liquidation rights
of the holders of the Company&#8217;s Class A Common Stock are subject to and qualified by the rights, powers and preferences of the holders
of the Series A Preferred Stock (see Note 10).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>Contingent Sponsor Shares</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Pursuant to the sponsor support
and forfeiture agreement dated April 17, 2023 by and between Anzu, Envoy Medical Corporation and the Sponsor, as amended or modified from
time to time (the &#8220;Sponsor Support Agreement&#8221;), and as of the date of issuance, <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c162" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesIssuedForServices" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8439">1,000,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock held
by the Sponsor shall be unvested and subject to the restrictions and forfeiture provisions set forth in the Sponsor Support Agreement
(the &#8220;Contingent Sponsor Shares&#8221;). The Contingent Sponsor Shares were initially to vest upon the FDA&#8217;s approval of the Acclaim
CI. or a change of control of the Company.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On December 20, 2024, the
Company and the Sponsor entered into an agreement to remove the vesting restriction on the Contingent Sponsor Shares, more fully described
in Note 10 under &#8220;<i>Sponsor Induced Conversion</i>&#8221;.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>&#160;</i></p>

</div><ix:continuation continuedAt="_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_2" id="_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Forward Purchase Agreement Warrant Liability</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Pursuant to the terms of the
Forward Purchase Agreement, the Company issued to the Meteora Parties warrants to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c163" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8454">3,874,394</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock (the
&#8220;Shortfall Warrants&#8221;). As issued, the Shortfall Warrants had an exercise price determined based on the volume weighted average
price of the Class A Common Stock, subject to a $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c164" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8455">4.00</ix:nonFraction> price floor (the &#8220;Exercise Price Floor&#8221;), which Exercise Price Floor
is adjustable for certain issuances of Class A Common Stock at a price below the then-current Exercise Price Floor. The Shortfall Warrants
had an expiration date of June 30, 2024 upon issuance. The fair value of the Shortfall Warrants is presented as the forward purchase agreement
warrant liability on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets. The change in fair value of the Shortfall Warrants each period
is recorded within the change in fair value of forward purchase agreement warrant liability on the unaudited condensed consolidated statements
of operations and comprehensive loss.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On June 24, 2024, the Company
and the Meteora Parties entered into Amendment No. 1 to the Shortfall Warrants to extend the expiration of the Shortfall Warrants to December
31, 2024. Amendment No. 1 did not have a material effect on the Company&#8217;s financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2024.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On July 29, 2024, the Company
and the Meteora Parties entered into an amendment to the Forward Purchase Agreement to adjust the Exercise Price Floor of certain Shortfall
Warrants from $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c165" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8456">4.00</ix:nonFraction> to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c166" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8457">2.00</ix:nonFraction> for <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c167" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:NumberOfWarrantsSubjectToAdjustmentOfExercisePrice" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8458">1,000,000</ix:nonFraction> of the Shortfall Warrants, $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c168" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8459">3.00</ix:nonFraction> for an additional <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c169" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNonOptionEquityInstrumentsExercised" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8460">1,000,000</ix:nonFraction> Shortfall Warrants, and with remainder
of the Shortfall Warrants retaining the $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c170" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8461">4.00</ix:nonFraction> Exercise Price Floor.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On December 19, 2024, the
Company and the Meteora Parties entered into Amendment No. 2 to the Shortfall Warrants to extend the expiration date of the Shortfall
Warrants to December 31, 2025.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On July 28, 2025, the Company
and the Meteora Parties entered into Amendment No. 3 to the Shortfall Warrants that changed the Exercise Price Floor to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c171" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:WarrantExercisePriceDecrease" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8462">1.50</ix:nonFraction> for the
Shortfall Warrants that remained outstanding. The exercise price of the Shortfall Warrants continues to be based on the volume weighted
average price of the Class A Common Stock subject to the amended Exercise Price Floor.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On December 18, 2025, the
Company and the Meteora Parties entered into Amendment No. 4 to the Shortfall Warrants to extend the expiration date of the Shortfall
Warrants to December 31, 2026.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">During the three months ended
March 31, 2026 and 2025, the Meteora Parties did not exercise any Shortfall Warrants. As of March 31, 2026, Shortfall Warrants to purchase
<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c172" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightOutstanding" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8463">1,135,499</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock remained outstanding.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>Publicly Traded Warrants</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Company has <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c173" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8464">14,166,666</ix:nonFraction>
publicly traded warrants to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c174" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8465">14,166,666</ix:nonFraction> shares of its Class A Common Stock (&#8220;Publicly Traded Warrants&#8221;). The Publicly
Traded Warrants have an exercise price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c173" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8466">11.50</ix:nonFraction> and expire on <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c173" format="ixt:date-monthname-day-year-en" name="us-gaap:WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingMaturityDate" id="ixv-8467">September 29, 2028</ix:nonNumeric>.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>Term Loan Warrants</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">During the three months ended
March 31, 2025, the Company issued Term Loan Warrants to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c175" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8468">750,000</ix:nonFraction> shares, of its Class A Common Stock to a related party (see

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>September 2025 Offering</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On September 22, 2025, the
Company entered into purchase agreements with certain investors providing for the issuance and sale by the Company of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c176" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8469">1,908,402</ix:nonFraction> shares
of Class A Common Stock. The Class A Common Stock was offered at a price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c177" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8470">1.31</ix:nonFraction> per share for gross proceeds of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c176" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOffering" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8471">2,500</ix:nonFraction>. After deducting
direct offering expenses the net cash proceeds to the Company were $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c176" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOfCashDivested" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8472">2,187</ix:nonFraction>. The offering costs were recognized in the loss on offering
and change in fair value of private warrant liability in the Company&#8217;s consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss
during the period the offering closed. As part of the September 2025 Offering, the Company issued warrants to investors to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c177" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8473">5,725,206</ix:nonFraction>
shares of Class A Common Stock with an exercise price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c177" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8474">1.31</ix:nonFraction> (the &#8220;September 2025 Investor Warrants&#8221;) per share with each
of the investors acquiring <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c177" decimals="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" name="coch:NumberOfWarrantsUsedToPurchasesEachShareOfCommonStockToBeIssued" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8475">three</ix:nonFraction> warrants for every share of Class A Common Stock purchased (the &#8220;September 2025 Offering&#8221;).
The closing of the September 2025 Offering occurred on September 23, 2025.</p></ix:continuation><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center">&#160;</p><div>

</div><ix:continuation continuedAt="_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_3" id="_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_2"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The September 2025 Investor
Warrants include certain provisions that could result in a change in the settlement amount based on variables that are not inputs to a
&#8220;fixed-for-fixed&#8221; model, including certain provisions around a change in control transaction. As a result, the warrants do
not meet the criteria for equity classification and are accounted for as liabilities in accordance with ASC 815.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The September 2025 Investor
Warrants were initially recognized at fair value on the date of issuance using a Black-Scholes option model. The initial fair value of
the September 2025 Investor Warrants was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c178" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8476">3,193</ix:nonFraction>. Since the fair value of the September 2025 Investor Warrants amount exceeded the proceeds
from the September 2025 Offering, an immediate loss of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c179" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8477">693</ix:nonFraction> was recognized in the loss on offering and change in fair value of private
warrant liability during the period the September 2025 Offering closed in the Company&#8217;s consolidated statements of operations and
comprehensive loss resulting in the private warrant liability in the Company&#8217;s consolidated balance sheets being recorded as gross
proceeds.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The September 2025 Investor
Warrants are remeasured at fair value each reporting date until exercised. Changes in the fair value of the September 2025 Investor Warrants
are recognized in the loss on offering and change in fair value of private warrant liability on the Company&#8217;s statements of operations
and comprehensive loss.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Additional warrants were issued
to the placement agent to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c180" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8478">143,130</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock with an exercise price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c180" decimals="4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8479">1.6375</ix:nonFraction> per share (the &#8220;September
2025 Placement Agent Warrants&#8221; and collectively with the September 2025 Investor Warrants the &#8220;September 2025 Offering Warrants&#8221;).
The September 2025 Placement Agent Warrants were issued at <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c181" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:PricePerNewlyIssuedWarrantsPercentageOnExercisePriceOfInvestorWarrants" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8480">125</ix:nonFraction>% of the exercise price of the September 2025 Investor Warrants, based on
<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c181" decimals="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:InvestorWarrantsPercentageOfCommonStockIssued" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8481">7.5</ix:nonFraction>% of Class A Common Stock issued as part of the September 2025 Offering, and the placement agent will be compensated in the same manner
for future offerings under the engagement agreement. The September 2025 Placement Agent Warrants are classified as contingently redeemable
in accordance with ASC 718,&#160;<i>Compensation - Stock Compensation&#160;</i>(&#8220;ASC 718&#8221;). These warrants qualify for equity
classification, however, because the September 2025 Placement Agent Warrants could be settled in cash or other assets upon a contingent
redemption that is not solely within the Company&#8217;s control, the September 2025 Placement Agent Warrants have been classified as
temporary equity and reported as warrants issued to placement agent as part of the 2025 Offerings (as defined below) in mezzanine equity
on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets. Upon issuance, the September 2025 Placement Agent Warrants were recognized at
fair value using a Black-Scholes option model and the Company recognized $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c182" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:NoninterestExpenseOfferingCost" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8482">130</ix:nonFraction> of expense recorded in the loss on offering and change in
fair value of private warrant liability on the unaudited condensed consolidated statement of operations and comprehensive loss for the
year ended December 31, 2025 as the service was completed upon closing of the September 2025 Offering. The contingent redemption event
is not probable and the September 2025 Placement Agent Warrants are not currently redeemable. Accordingly, the September 2025 Placement
Agent Warrants are presented at grant date fair value on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets.</p>

the September 2025 Offering Warrants.</p>

</div><ix:continuation continuedAt="_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_4" id="_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_3"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The October 2025 Investor
Warrants include certain provisions that could result in a change in the settlement amount based on variables that are not inputs to a
&#8220;fixed-for-fixed&#8221; model, including certain provisions around a change in control transaction. As a result, the warrants do
not meet the criteria for equity classification and are accounted for as liabilities in accordance with ASC 815.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The October 2025 Investor
Warrants were initially recognized at fair value on the date of issuance using a Black-Scholes option model. The initial fair value of
the October 2025 Investor Warrants was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c186" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8491">6,035</ix:nonFraction>. Since the fair value of the October 2025 Investor Warrants amount exceeded the proceeds
from the October 2025 Offering, an immediate loss of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c187" decimals="-3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-8492">2,035</ix:nonFraction> was recognized in the loss on offering and change in fair value of private
warrant liability during the period the October 2025 Offering closed in the Company&#8217;s unaudited condensed consolidated statements
of operations and comprehensive loss resulting in the private warrant liability in the Company&#8217;s unaudited condensed consolidated
balance sheets being recorded as gross proceeds.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The October 2025 Investor
Warrants are remeasured at fair value each reporting date until exercised. Changes in the fair value of the October 2025 Investor Warrants
are recognized in the loss on offering and change in fair value of private warrant liability on the Company&#8217;s statements of operations
and comprehensive loss.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Additional warrants were issued
to the placement agent to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c188" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8493">225,564</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock with an exercise price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c188" decimals="4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8494">1.6625</ix:nonFraction> per share (the &#8220;October

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The February 2026 Offering
included beneficial ownership limitations preventing the purchaser, together with its affiliates and certain related parties, from beneficially
owning more than <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c203" decimals="4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:InvestorWarrantsPercentageOfCommonStockIssued" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8519">4.99</ix:nonFraction>% (or, at the election of the investor, <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c204" decimals="4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:InvestorWarrantsPercentageOfCommonStockIssued" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8520">9.99</ix:nonFraction>%) of the Company&#8217;s outstanding Class A Common Stock.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Company evaluated the
February 2026 Offering Warrants under ASC 815 and determined that they met the requirements for equity classification and are classified
in stockholders&#8217; equity. In the event of certain change-in-control or similar transactions, the Series A Warrants provide for settlement
in the same form of consideration received by holders of the Company&#8217;s Class A Common Stock and do not permit net cash settlement
at the option of the holder except in circumstances consistent with equity classification under ASC 815-40. Accordingly, the proceeds
were recorded as additional paid-in capital on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets and are not subject to remeasurement
on an ongoing basis.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Additional warrants were issued
to the placement agent to purchase <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c205" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-8521">3,750,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of Class A Common Stock with an exercise price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c206" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8522">0.50</ix:nonFraction> per share (the &#8220;February
2026 Placement Agent Warrants&#8221;). The February 2026 Placement Agent Warrants become exercisable on the Stockholder Approval Date
and expire on the earlier of (i) the 24 month anniversary of the Stockholder Approval Date, (ii) 30 days following the date the Company
publicly announces that it has received FDA approval for the Acclaim CI, and (iii) and in no event later than February 11, 2031.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The February 2026 Placement
Agent Warrants were issued with an exercise price equal to <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c204" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:PricePerNewlyIssuedWarrantsPercentageOnExercisePriceOfInvestorWarrants" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8523">125</ix:nonFraction>% of the price per share of the Class A Common Stock issued in the February
2026 Offering and represented <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c207" decimals="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="coch:PricePerNewlyIssuedWarrantsPercentageOnExercisePriceOfInvestorWarrants" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8524">5.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the aggregate Class A Common Stock and Issued Pre-Funded Warrants sold in the February
2026 Offering.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The February 2026 Placement
Agent Warrants are contingently redeemable in accordance with ASC 718 and include a contingent redemption feature that is solely within
the Company&#8217;s control. As a result, the warrants qualify for equity classification and are included within additional paid-in capital
on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets. The February 2026 Placement Agent Warrants are also a direct offering expense
that are charged against proceeds of the February 2026 Offering within additional paid-in capital resulting in no impact to shareholders&#8217;
equity (deficit).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>Voting Rights</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The holders of the Series
A Preferred Stock are not entitled to vote or receive notice of any meeting of stockholders, except in the case that the Company creates
any equity or debt instrument that ranks senior or pari passu to the rights of the Series A Preferred Stock or in the case of any adverse
change to the powers, preferences or special rights of the Series A Preferred Stock.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>Conversion Rights</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Each share of Series A Preferred
Stock shall be convertible, at the option of the holder, at any time after the date of issuance into such number of shares of Class A
Common Stock as determined by dividing the issuance price of the shares of Series A Preferred Stock of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c235" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockConvertibleConversionPrice" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8541">10.00</ix:nonFraction>, by the conversion price,
which was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockConvertibleConversionPrice" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8542">11.50</ix:nonFraction> per share as of March 31, 2026 and is adjustable for certain dilutive events.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>Redemption</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The holders of Series A Preferred
Stock are not entitled to any redemption rights, other than those under their liquidation rights discussed below. The Company does not
have the option to redeem the Series A Preferred Stock.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><i>Dividend Rights</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

Stock are entitled to a cumulative dividend which accrues at the rate of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c236" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendRatePercentage" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8543">12</ix:nonFraction>% of the original issuance price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c236" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsPerShareDeclared" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-8544">10.00</ix:nonFraction> per share per annum
(&#8220;Regular Dividend&#8221;). The Regular Dividend accrues on a daily basis from and including the issuance date of such shares, whether
or not declared, and will be payable in cash on a quarterly basis. If the Company fails to pay the Regular Dividends on the dividend payment
date, then an additional dividend on the amount of the unpaid portion shall automatically accrue at <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendRatePercentage" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-8545">12</ix:nonFraction>%. The Company did not pay Regular
Dividends starting in the quarter ended September 30, 2025 or during any following quarters.</p></ix:nonNumeric><div>
